listings.description:
Some properties impress with their views.

Some properties stand out for their location.

And there are a few that offer the opportunity to create something truly extraordinary.

Villa Escondida combines all three.

Located on one of the most privileged oceanfronts on the Peninsula Caracol, this residence enjoys an exceptional combination of privacy, architecture, and unobstructed panoramic views of the Sea of Cortez. From its terraces, social areas, and private spaces, the view encompasses the sea, the mountains, and the spectacular sunsets that are the hallmark of San Carlos.

The current residence was designed to make the most of its natural surroundings. It features three spacious bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, comfortable living areas, terraces for enjoying the outdoors, and a separate garage that enhances the property’s functionality.

However, what makes Villa Escondida particularly interesting is its potential for the future.

Recognizing the growing demand for spaces designed for larger families, the residence’s original architect has developed conceptual proposals that would allow for a significant expansion of the property. The plans call for the construction of additional living areas above the existing garage structure, incorporating new bedrooms and living spaces that would comfortably accommodate children, grandchildren, relatives, and guests.

Proposals have also been prepared for a pool with an ocean view. An important detail is that much of the infrastructure needed for this project is already in place, facilitating future development for those who wish to bring this vision to its fullest potential.

For many Mexican families, a second home represents much more than just a vacation property. It is the place where different generations come together, where important occasions are celebrated, and where memories are made that last for decades.

Villa Escondida offers precisely that possibility.

It can be enjoyed today as an elegant oceanfront residence or, over time, become an exceptional family heirloom, designed to welcome multiple generations under one roof without sacrificing privacy, comfort, or exclusivity.

Oceanfront properties are scarce. Properties that offer privacy are even harder to find. And those that also offer a clear vision for growth and evolution are truly exceptional.

Villa Escondida is a rare opportunity to acquire not just a residence, but a property with the potential to become one of San Carlos’s great family homes.

Qué es un pool de rentas?
Un pool de rentas es un modelo de inversión inmobiliaria donde varios propietarios agrupan sus unidades (departamentos, suites, locales) bajo una administración conjunta para rentarlas, generalmente en esquemas vacacionales o de corta estancia. Todos los ingresos generados se agrupan en una "bolsa común" y se distribuyen proporcionalmente entre los participantes, independientemente de si su unidad específica estuvo ocupada, lo que ofrece ingresos más estables y sin la carga operativa de la gestión directa.

Beneficios del Pool de rentas:

Agrupación y Gestión:
Las unidades se integran en un desarrollo y una empresa administradora profesional se encarga de todo: mantenimiento, limpieza, marketing y atención al cliente.
Ingresos Comunes:
Los ingresos de todas las unidades se juntan, descontando los costos operativos (mantenimiento, administración) antes de repartir las ganancias.
Distribución de Ganancias:
La utilidad se reparte entre los dueños de acuerdo con su porcentaje de participación o el tiempo que su unidad estuvo disponible, no necesariamente por ocupación individual.
Propiedad y Rentabilidad:
Aunque el inmueble se renta bajo este esquema, el inversionista sigue siendo dueño de su unidad bajo escritura notariada e inscrita ante el Registro Público de la Propiedad, pudiendo venderla o hipotecarla, siempre que el nuevo propietario acepte el contrato de pool.
